supplier_pricing.description: Distributor cost feeds flow into your flat-rate book. Preview the re-priced catalog, then apply — every change writes a new pricebook version, never rewrites history.
supplier_pricing.history_description: Only price changes caused by supplier cost feeds appear here.
supplier_pricing.history_empty: No supplier-driven changes for this item yet.
supplier_pricing.ingest_api_notice: Live distributor API is not connected yet (TODO(LIVE)). Use the mock or CSV feed to reprice offline.
supplier_pricing.ingest_csv_placeholder: Paste CSV here — header row with sku,cost columns…
supplier_pricing.ingest_mock_description: Generates a deterministic demo cost feed from your cataloged SKUs — no network calls.
supplier_pricing.mappings_description: Pin a supplier SKU to a specific pricebook item when the codes don't match. Mappings win over direct SKU matches.
supplier_pricing.margin_rules_description: Flat-rate sell price = cost ÷ (1 − margin). Set your target margin per category and how prices round.
supplier_pricing.no_mappings: No explicit mappings — items match feed lines by SKU.
supplier_pricing.no_suppliers: No suppliers yet. Add your first distributor to start feeding costs.
supplier_pricing.reprice_confirm: Apply {{n}} price change(s)? This writes a new pricebook version per item.
supplier_pricing.reprice_description: Preview applies your margin rules to the latest costs. Nothing is written until you hit Apply.
supplier_pricing.reprice_empty: Ingest a cost feed first, then preview re-pricing.
supplier_pricing.reprice_no_changes: Costs are in sync — no price changes proposed.
supplier_pricing.summary_line: {{changed}} of {{total}} items change · {{unmapped}} unmapped feed lines · total Δ {{delta}}
supplier_pricing.supplier_confirm_delete: Remove this supplier and its feed lines?
supplier_pricing.title: Supplier Pricing
